tasks.gr8-visual-arts-t2: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover principles of design, pattern, printmaking, collage, and African visual references. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify design principles, explain repetition and contrast, and choose methods for print and collage process tasks.
tasks.gr8-music-t2: Topic: Music. Cover South African music styles, melody, texture, ensemble balance, and call-and-response. Ask Grade 8 learners to compare styles, identify musical texture, and select ensemble decisions that improve blend and timing.
tasks.gr8-drama-t2: Topic: Drama. Cover storytelling, script excerpts, improvisation, focus, tension, and audience awareness. Ask Grade 8 learners to shape scenes with clear structure, recognise dramatic tension, and choose staging choices that support communication.
tasks.gr8-dance-t2: Topic: Dance. Cover motif development, folk or social dance influences, rhythm, group patterns, and coordination. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify motifs, suggest development methods, and select coordination strategies for partner and group performance.
tasks.gr8-ca-triplets-f-major-t2: Topic: Triplets, F major, dynamics and tempo words. Cover the triplet (three notes in the time of one crotchet beat), the F major scale (one flat, B flat) and reading in C, G and F major in 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4, the dynamics piano, forte, crescendo and diminuendo and the tempo words allegro (fast) and andante (walking pace). Ask Grade 8 learners to count beats in bars with triplets, name the flat in F major and match the music words to their meanings.
tasks.gr8-ca-poetry-praise-t2: Topic: South African poetry and praise poetry. Cover interpreting a poem (text analysis in own words, vocal clarity, variation in pitch, pace and tone, justified pauses and emphasis, physical expressiveness, emotional connection, mood, audience contact) and praise poetry (descriptive naming phrases, repetition, rhythm, call and response, role of the praise poet in a community, body language, build in pace and volume, costume). Do not quote any real poem. Ask Grade 8 learners to match voice and body tools to a purpose and to identify the features of praise poetry.
tasks.gr8-ca-fashion-design-t2: Topic: Fashion design from recyclables. Cover fashion through the ages and its function, fashion as popular culture and respecting other opinions, designing and making a three-dimensional garment from recyclable materials (planning, preliminary drawings, stitching, tying, pasting, wrapping), safe tool use, sharing and concern for the environment, and careers in fashion (designer, pattern maker, tailor or seamstress, stylist, textile designer). Ask Grade 8 learners to match jobs and choose safe, sensible practice.
tasks.gr8-ca-societal-issues-art-t2: Topic: Societal issues in South African art. Cover the artist as social commentator, looking, interpreting and responding to an image, symbols (a dove for peace, an empty plate for hunger, joined hands for unity, a tree in rubbish for hope), pencil drawing with 2B, 3B and 4B pencils (a higher B is softer and darker), planning with sketches and different paper sizes, and respect for other views. Do not name real artists or artworks. Ask Grade 8 learners to interpret symbols, choose pencils for tone and plan a drawing.
